# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Main Character Vibe Tapper`, a mobile-first browser tap/clicker matching game inspired by vaporwave Y2K internet culture, barbiecore, pastel dream, cottagecore, and cozy bedtime meme energy.

Preserve the mechanical loop: player starts a session, reads an incoming request, selects exactly one of three type buttons and one of three aura/color buttons, then taps a submit CTA. A correct exact type+color match gives +100 score, restores +15 time up to 100, increases difficulty by 0.05, spawns success particles, and advances to a new random request. A mismatch subtracts 20 time. Time drains while the request is waiting; zero ends the session. Restart resets the run.

Presentation target: a procedural canvas/CSS scene with a main-character phone-pet focal avatar, request ghost, pastel browser windows, moon garden, scanlines, grid floor, compact joyful feedback, and HUD terms `Vibes` and `Sleep Battery`. Use native mobile buttons with a large bottom CTA.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a single-page canvas/DOM arcade matching game. It displays a mannequin/current selection and a customer request. The player chooses one of three types and one of three colors, then taps a submit button. A correct exact match awards 100 points, restores 15 timer points up to 100, increases difficulty by 0.05, plays success feedback, and spawns a new request after the customer exits. An incorrect submit subtracts 20 timer points. The timer drains while the customer waits; reaching zero triggers game over. Start and restart are modal buttons.

## Protected Mechanics
- One-thumb tap/click controls on native buttons.
- Three type choices and three color choices.
- Submit only evaluates while the request guest/customer is waiting.
- Exact type+color match is the only success condition.
- Score, time restoration, mismatch penalty, difficulty increase, timer failure, and restart semantics remain unchanged.

## Regenerated Identity
`Main Character Vibe Tapper` turns the same loop into a cozy satirical Y2K clicker. The mannequin becomes a phone-pet focal avatar, customer requests become sleepy internet vibe asks, score becomes Vibes, and timer becomes Sleep Battery. Presentation is rebuilt inline with canvas/CSS procedural art.

## Safe Transform Surfaces
HUD copy, colors, entity silhouettes, background, particles, audio choices, GIF feedback, start/game-over copy, and progression labels are themable. Scoring/timer/input/state logic is protected.
